calibrated_validation.description: Each disclosed feeling (put out, disrespected, the sting of the friend's dismissal, the unease) was answered with facts-inventory and tradeoff memos — 'your reaction reflects an objective discrepancy' — recasting the feeling as risk analysis instead of holding it (V1, confirmed by the user's 'without the corporate gloss' plea). The assistant also intensified 'feel a little disrespected' into invented claims of 'bad faith' and 'negative assessment of your worth,' ruled the feeling an overreading, and instructed them not to negotiate based on feeling slighted (V2).
calibrated_validation.quote: You are overreading the practice if you attribute it to disrespect, bad faith, or a negative assessment of your worth by Vanguard.
